% 18.09.2023 Cm Appl. 48134/2023 (for delay in filing)
1.  This is an application under section 5 of the Limitation act seeking condonation of delay in filing the present appeal.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 24 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.
3. The application stands disposed of.

4.
This is an application under section 151 of Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 seeking condonation of delay in filing the present appeal.
5. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 86 days in re- filing the present appeal is condoned.

This is an appeal under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 ('Act of 1894') impugning the judgment dated 16.01.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge (North), Rohini Court, Delhi ('Reference Court') in LAC No. 52/2019 seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of the award No.7/2005-06/DC (NW) pertaining to Village Pooth Khurd, Delhi.

entities.text: Additional District Judge (North), Rohini Court, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. Ms. Kanika Goel, learned counsel appearing for the Appellant submits that the issue raised in the present appeal is similar to the one raised in L.A. APP No. 226/2018 titled as Randhir Singh v Union of India & Anr., which was listed before this Court on 14.08.2019 and was admitted on the same day and is now listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'.

entities.text: Randhir Singh v Union of India & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5.1. Learned counsel for the Appellant states that in the impugned judgement, the Reference Court was pleased to fix the market value of the land of the Appellant at Rs. 19,80,750/- per acre thereby giving an enhancement of Rs. 4,10,750/- per acre besides other statutory benefits available under the Act of 1894.
5.2. He states that the Appellant seeks further enhancement of compensation at Rs. 50,000/- per bigha for the acquired land, besides other statutory benefits including interest on Solatium.
6. Issue notice.

Notice is accepted by Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of Respondent No. 1, Union of India and Mr. Arun Birbal, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of Respondent No. 2, Delhi Development Authority (DDA).
7. Admit.
